name: Qwen3-TTS-API
description: OpenAI-compatible TTS API powered by Qwen3-TTS with CUDA graph acceleration (7-10x faster). 10 languages, 9 built-in voices, voice cloning, emotion control, streaming output. Supports RTX 50-series (Blackwell) GPUs. First start downloads model (~3-7GB) from HuggingFace. China users: set HF_ENDPOINT to https://hf-mirror.com for faster downloads. Requires NVIDIA GPU with driver 550+.

paths.name: Model Cache
paths.description: Model download cache. First run downloads ~3-7GB. Persists across container recreates.

ports.name: API Port
ports.description: OpenAI-compatible TTS API port. Swagger docs at /docs

variables.name: Model ID
variables.description: Model to load. Base models support voice clone. CustomVoice models have 9 built-in voices. See README for all options.

variables.name: Dtype
variables.description: Model precision. bfloat16 recommended. Use float16 for older GPUs without bf16 support.

variables.name: HuggingFace Endpoint
variables.description: HuggingFace download mirror. China users: change to https://hf-mirror.com
